mapper.select: SELECT * FROM s_notification WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE s_notification SET read_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT n.* FROM s_notification n WHERE (n.status = 'PENDING_DELIVERY' AND (n.delivery_next_attempt_at IS NULL OR n.delivery_next_attempt_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR n.status = 'DELIVERING' AND n.delivery_claimed_at < DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE)) ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE s_notification SET status = 'MOCK_SENT', delivery_claimed_at = NULL, delivery_next_attempt_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DELIVERING'
UPDATE s_notification SET status = 'SKIPPED', delivery_claimed_at = NULL, delivery_next_attempt_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DELIVERING'

UPDATE s_notification SET status = 'DELIVERING', delivery_claimed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND (status = 'PENDING_DELIVERY' AND (delivery_next_attempt_at IS NULL OR delivery_next_attempt_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR status = 'DELIVERING' AND delivery_claimed_at < DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE))
UPDATE s_notification SET status = 'PENDING_DELIVERY', delivery_claimed_at = NULL, delivery_next_attempt_at = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 30 SECOND) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DELIVERING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s_notification n JOIN s_user_account u ON u.id = n.user_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN s_booking b ON n.type = 'ARRIVAL_REMINDER' AND b.id = n.booking_id LEFT JOIN s_reminder_subscription rs ON rs.id = n.subscription_id AND rs.user_id = n.user_id LEFT JOIN s_session_slot ss ON n.type = 'SLOT_RELEASED_ALERT' AND ss.id = n.business_id WHERE n.id = #{id} AND (n.type NOT IN ('ARRIVAL_REMINDER', 'OPENING_ALERT', 'SLOT_RELEASED_ALERT') OR (n.type = 'ARRIVAL_REMINDER' AND b.user_id = n.user_id AND b.source = 'ONLINE' AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND b.start_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)) OR (n.type = 'OPENING_ALERT' AND rs.status = 'ACTIVE' AND rs.type = 'OPENING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_session_slot available JOIN s_venue v ON v.id = available.venue_id AND v.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN s_court c ON c.id = available.court_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN s_court_sport cs ON cs.court_id = c.id AND cs.sport_type_id = available.sport_type_id JOIN s_sport_type st ON st.id = available.sport_type_id AND st.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE available.venue_id = rs.venue_id AND available.sport_type_id = rs.sport_type_id AND available.slot_date = rs.target_date AND available.status = 'OPEN' AND available.slot_date >= DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), '+00:00', '+08:00')) AND available.slot_date < DATE_ADD( DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), '+00:00', '+08:00')), INTERVAL v.booking_days_ahead DAY) AND available.start_at > DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL v.min_booking_minutes MINUTE) AND TIME(CONVERT_TZ(available.start_at, '+00:00', '+08:00')) >= rs.start_time AND TIME(CONVERT_TZ(available.end_at, '+00:00', '+08:00')) <= rs.end_time)) OR (n.type = 'SLOT_RELEASED_ALERT' AND rs.status = 'ACTIVE' AND rs.type = 'RELEASED' AND ss.venue_id = rs.venue_id AND ss.sport_type_id = rs.sport_type_id AND ss.slot_date = rs.target_date AND ss.status = 'OPEN' AND TIME(CONVERT_TZ(ss.start_at, '+00:00', '+08:00')) >= rs.start_time AND TIME(CONVERT_TZ(ss.end_at, '+00:00', '+08:00')) <= rs.end_time AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_venue v JOIN s_court c ON c.id = ss.court_id JOIN s_court_sport cs ON cs.court_id = c.id AND cs.sport_type_id = ss.sport_type_id JOIN s_sport_type st ON st.id = ss.sport_type_id WHERE v.id = ss.venue_id AND v.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND st.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ss.slot_date >= DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), '+00:00', '+08:00')) AND ss.slot_date < DATE_ADD( DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), '+00:00', '+08:00')), INTERVAL v.booking_days_ahead DAY) AND ss.start_at > DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL v.min_booking_minutes MINUTE))))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_notification (user_id, booking_id, business_type, business_id, type, title, content, idempotency_key, status, created_at) SELECT b.user_id, b.id, 'BOOKING', b.id, 'ARRIVAL_REMINDER', #{title}, #{content}, #{key}, 'PENDING_DELIVERY', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM s_booking b JOIN s_user_account u ON u.id = b.user_id WHERE b.id = #{bookingId} AND b.source = 'ONLINE' AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND b.start_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND b.start_at <= DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 2 HOUR) AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE idempotency_key = VALUES(idempotency_key)

INSERT INTO s_notification (user_id, business_type, business_id, subscription_id, type, title, content, idempotency_key, status, created_at) SELECT DISTINCT s.user_id, 'REMINDER_SUBSCRIPTION', s.id, s.id, 'OPENING_ALERT', '场次已开售', '你登记的日期和时段已有可预约场次，名额未为你保留，请重新查询。', CONCAT('alert:opening:', s.id), 'PENDING_DELIVERY', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM s_reminder_subscription s JOIN s_user_account u ON u.id = s.user_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN s_venue v ON v.id = s.venue_id AND v.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN s_session_slot slot ON slot.venue_id = s.venue_id AND slot.sport_type_id = s.sport_type_id AND slot.slot_date = s.target_date AND slot.status = 'OPEN' JOIN s_court c ON c.id = slot.court_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN s_court_sport cs ON cs.court_id = c.id AND cs.sport_type_id = slot.sport_type_id JOIN s_sport_type st ON st.id = slot.sport_type_id AND st.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.type = 'OPENING' AND s.opening_notified_at IS NULL AND slot.start_at > DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL v.min_booking_minutes MINUTE) AND s.target_date >= DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), '+00:00', '+08:00')) AND s.target_date < DATE_ADD(DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), '+00:00', '+08:00')), INTERVAL v.booking_days_ahead DAY) AND TIME(CONVERT_TZ(slot.start_at, '+00:00', '+08:00')) >= s.start_time AND TIME(CONVERT_TZ(slot.end_at, '+00:00', '+08:00')) <= s.end_time ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE idempotency_key = VALUES(idempotency_key)

INSERT INTO s_notification (user_id, business_type, business_id, subscription_id, type, title, content, idempotency_key, status, created_at) SELECT DISTINCT s.user_id, 'SESSION_SLOT', slot.id, s.id, 'SLOT_RELEASED_ALERT', '有空位了', '目标时段刚刚释放一个具体场次，名额未为你保留，请重新查询。', CONCAT('alert:', e.event_key, ':', s.id), 'PENDING_DELIVERY', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM s_slot_release_event e JOIN s_session_slot slot ON slot.id = e.session_slot_id AND slot.status = 'OPEN' JOIN s_reminder_subscription s ON s.venue_id = slot.venue_id AND s.sport_type_id = slot.sport_type_id AND s.target_date = slot.slot_date AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.type = 'RELEASED' AND s.created_at <= e.created_at AND s.start_time <= TIME(CONVERT_TZ(slot.start_at, '+00:00', '+08:00')) AND s.end_time >= TIME(CONVERT_TZ(slot.end_at, '+00:00', '+08:00')) JOIN s_user_account u ON u.id = s.user_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN s_venue v ON v.id = slot.venue_id AND v.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN s_court c ON c.id = slot.court_id AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN s_court_sport cs ON cs.court_id = c.id AND cs.sport_type_id = slot.sport_type_id JOIN s_sport_type st ON st.id = slot.sport_type_id AND st.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE e.processed_at IS NULL AND e.id IN #{id} AND slot.start_at > DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL v.min_booking_minutes MINUTE) AND slot.slot_date >= DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), '+00:00', '+08:00')) AND slot.slot_date < DATE_ADD(DATE(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), '+00:00', '+08:00')), INTERVAL v.booking_days_ahead DAY) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE idempotency_key = VALUES(idempotency_key)

INSERT INTO s_notification (user_id, booking_id, business_type, business_id, type, title, content, idempotency_key, status, created_at) SELECT b.user_id, b.id, 'BOOKING', b.id, 'ARRIVAL_REMINDER', '到场提醒', CONCAT('你的 ', b.venue_name, ' 预约将于 ', DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(b.start_at, '+00:00', '+08:00'), '%m月%d日 %H:%i'), ' 开始，请打开预约详情查看导航、入场须知和核销凭证。'), CONCAT('alert:arrival:', b.id), 'PENDING_DELIVERY', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) FROM s_booking b JOIN s_user_account u ON u.id = b.user_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE b.source = 'ONLINE' AND b.status = 'CONFIRMED' AND b.user_id IS NOT NULL AND b.start_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) AND b.start_at <= DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), INTERVAL 2 HOUR) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_notification n WHERE n.idempotency_key = CONCAT('alert:arrival:', b.id)) ORDER BY b.start_at, b.id LIMIT 200 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE idempotency_key = VALUES(idempotency_key)
